landing.title: {{name}}
landing.lead: Prepare for the citizenship knowledge test. Understand every question in your own language, then practise in German. Try free sample questions first, then unlock everything with a Civics Pass.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Create your own account to study for the citizenship knowledge test. Accounts are for people aged 16 and over.
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it within 24 hours to activate your account.
signup.cantonHint: The canton where you will take the test. You can change it later.
signup.studyLanguageHint: The language you want to understand the questions and answers in first.
signup.interfaceLanguageHint: The language of menus and buttons. Where a translation is missing, English is shown.
signup.passwordOptionalHint: Without a password you sign in with a link we email you. You can add or remove a password later in your account.
signup.checkEmailSignIn: The link also signs you in.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.

verify.title: Confirming your email
verify.ok: Your email address is confirmed. You can log in now.
verify.retryHint: Log in and request a new confirmation link if yours has expired.
verify.signedIn: Your email address is confirmed and you are signed in.

login.title: Log in
login.linkIntro: Enter your email address and we will send you a sign-in link. It works once, for 15 minutes.
login.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
login.useLink: Sign in with an email link instead
login.checkEmailBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a sign-in link is on its way. Open it within 15 minutes on this device or another.
login.checkEmailHint: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder, or create an account if you do not have one yet.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address and we will send a link that works for 30 minutes.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.ok: Your password has been changed. Please log in.

twofa.optional: Add a second factor to protect your account.
twofa.setupSteps: Scan the code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or a similar app, or type in the key. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twofa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twofa.verifyIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.

billingReturn.title: Payment
billingReturn.cancelled: Checkout was cancelled. Nothing has been charged.
billingReturn.active: Thank you. Your Civics Pass is active.
billingReturn.waiting: Waiting for Stripe to confirm your payment. This usually takes a few seconds…

billingReturn.activeUntil: Thank you. Your Civics Pass for {{canton}} is active until {{date}}.

learner.noticeBody: The explanations here are written by an AI assistant and can contain mistakes. Use them to understand a question, and check anything important against the information from your canton.

learner.nearLimit: You are close to this month's message limit.
learner.integrity: The tutor explains and coaches; it does not give legal advice.

chat.intro: Tell the tutor what you are working on, or where you are stuck.
chat.placeholder: Type your question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.helplineTitle: Someone to talk to, right now
chat.helplineBody: Die Dargebotene Hand (Swiss helpline): call 143, free and confidential, 24 hours a day. In an emergency call 144 (ambulance) or 117 (police). It also helps to talk to someone you trust.
chat.dailyLimit: You have reached today's message limit. The tutor is back tomorrow.
chat.monthlyLimit: You have reached this month's message limit.
chat.checkIntro: Answer these on your own, then see how your mastery moves.
chat.checkEmpty: There are no check questions for this topic yet.

usage.intro: AI calls since {{date}}. Costs use list prices converted to CHF; the invoice from the provider is authoritative.

admin.title: Admin
admin.staffIntro: Admin accounts are created with the seed script on the server. Every admin uses two-factor authentication.
admin.refundConfirm: Refund this payment in full through Stripe? Access ends when Stripe confirms the refund.
admin.refundOverrideConfirm: This payment falls outside the refund rule. Refund it in full anyway? Access ends when Stripe confirms the refund.
admin.refundRequested: Refund sent to Stripe. Access changes when Stripe confirms it.

diagnostic.title: Find your gaps
diagnostic.doneBody: Here is where you stand. Start with the weakest topics; your mastery updates as you practise.
diagnostic.empty: There are no questions for this check yet.

practice.roundBodyPerfect: Every question right. Expect something a little harder next time.
practice.roundBodyGreat: Nearly all right. One more round and this topic is yours.
practice.roundBodyGood: Half or more right. Look through the solutions you missed and have another go.
practice.roundBodyKeep: A tough round. That is exactly what practice is for; the tutor can walk you through the tricky ones.

qbank.translationsIntro: Over the {{count}} approved German questions. Out-of-date translations were made from an earlier German version and are hidden from learners.

account.passwordOff: You sign in with an email link. You can add a password if you prefer.

pricing.title: Civics Pass
pricing.intro: Start with free practice. A Civics Pass opens everything for one canton: all questions and study modes, unlimited mock tests and Explain this, in every language. You pay once; there is no subscription.
pricing.passIncludes: All questions and study modes for this canton, unlimited mock tests and Explain this.
pricing.extensionNote: Need more time? An extension adds {{months}} months for {{price}}, while your pass is active or up to 90 days after it ends.
pricing.priceNote: Prices in CHF. Paid once, by card or TWINT, through Stripe.
pricing.unavailable: Prices are not available right now. Please try again shortly.
pricing.refundEligible: Not what you hoped for? Your last payment can be refunded until {{date}} if you have studied fewer than {{max}} questions since buying (so far: {{count}}).
pricing.writeToSupport: Write to support to ask for a refund.
pricing.refundTooLate: The refund period for your last payment ended on {{date}}.
pricing.refundTooMany: Your last payment can no longer be refunded: you have studied {{count}} questions since buying, and refunds are possible below {{max}}.
pricing.refundDone: Your last payment has been refunded.
